name: Navigant Corporate Advisors Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2012, Navigant Corporate 
Advisors provides Merchant Banking and Advisory Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is a SEBI-registered Category 
I – Merchant Banker. It provides integrated 
 capital market advisory and financial services 
 to Corporate and HNI Clients, and also has associations with intermediaries of Capital 
& Debt Market in India and overseas to raise funds. 
Company mainly participates in the SME Segment of Primary market issues, Valuation Advisory besides handling various assignments 
 on Rights Issues, Delisting, Open Offers, Exit 
Offer for Companies on Disseminations Board 
 and various valuation exercises including ESOP 
 advisory.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.6% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.53 Cr.
